A cat’s guide to the kampung

Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Hold Shift to run, press Space to jump, and E to meow.

Drag anywhere in the village to turn the camera. Scroll to zoom. Walk over the floating fish to collect them. Meow near villagers to say hello, meet the roaming cats, and look for butterflies around the flower gardens. On a phone, use the on-screen controls.
